node.title: L1 FPC5: large-source full-petal payment
node.statement: Aggregate every first-owned FPC5 contributor on the remaining large source scales. The exact official lower source sizes are M>=5 at rates 1/2 and 1/4, M>=7 at rate 1/8, and M>=15 at rate 1/16. In every cell, 2<=t<2M-4, d<ell(M-2), and max(0,2d+1-t ell)->infinity. The conclusion is one disjoint polynomial/profile allocation across source layouts, touched-petal sets, defects, and exact owners.
node.attack_surface: derive a large-M collective incidence or first-owner theorem; exploit the source equation and deficit coordinates without enumerating layouts or touched-petal subsets
node.falsifier: an official large-source first-owned FPC5 family exceeding every polynomial and legitimate quotient/profile column
